prompt:
Create a high-quality stylized 3D medieval fantasy grandstand matching the reference image.

Preserve the original proportions, colors and design: two ivory stone towers with blue pointed roofs, a long blue-and-white striped canopy, wooden support pillars, three clearly defined tiers of spectator seating, wooden railings and a solid stone wall foundation.

Prioritize clean, accurate geometry. Keep the seating steps distinct, canopy smoothly curved, pillars straight and architectural parts clearly separated. Build solid 3D geometry on all sides.

Avoid warped shapes, melted details, fused parts, floating objects and unnecessary additions. Clean quad topology, hand-painted game art style. No ground or characters.
